    {"legacy_difference_budget": 0, "legacy_differences_applied": 0},
    {"legacy_difference_budget": 1, "legacy_differences_applied": 1},

    item.update(
        {
            "terminal_status": "ACTIVE",
            "actual_first_attempt_turn": None,

def canonical(value: Any) -> str:
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)


def sha256(value: Any) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical(value).encode()).hexdigest()


def load(evidence: Path, selector: str, seed: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    path = evidence / f"{selector}-{seed}.json"
    if not path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"missing diagnostic evidence: {path}")
    value = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if value["selector"] != selector or int(value["seed"]) != seed:
        raise SystemExit(f"diagnostic identity mismatch: {path}")
    if value["status"] != "PASS":
        raise SystemExit(f"diagnostic did not pass: {path}")
    return value


def sanitized_action(action: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    return {
        key: value
        for key, value in action.items()
        if key not in {"internal_opaque_handle"}
    }


def first_difference(
    repaired: dict[str, Any], legacy: dict[str, Any]
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    record = next(
        item
        for item in repaired["decisions"]
        if item["historical_and_repaired_selections_differ"]
    )
    index = int(record["decision_index"])
    legacy_record = legacy["decisions"][index]
    if record["tie_classification"] != "DISTINCT_PUBLIC_KEYS":
        raise SystemExit("first selector difference was not a distinct-public-key tie")
    if not record["difference_attributable_only_to_final_ordering"]:
        raise SystemExit("first selector difference was not isolated to final ordering")
    if record["pre_decision_full_state_hash"] != legacy_record["pre_decision_full_state_hash"]:
        raise SystemExit("pre-divergence full-state hashes differ")
    if record["public_observation_digest"] != legacy_record["public_observation_digest"]:
        raise SystemExit("pre-divergence public observation digests differ")
    top = record["top_substantive_score_prefix"]
    top_candidates = [
        sanitized_action(candidate)
        for candidate in record["candidates"]
        if candidate["substantive_score_prefix"] == top
    ]
    return {
        "decision_index": index,
        "turn_number": record["turn_number"],
        "phase": record["phase"],
        "step": record["step"],
        "priority_context": record["priority_context"],
        "public_observation_digest": record["public_observation_digest"],
        "pre_decision_full_state_hash": record["pre_decision_full_state_hash"],
        "pre_state_equal_between_counterfactuals": True,
        "top_substantive_score_prefix": top,
        "top_candidate_count": record["top_candidate_count"],
        "top_distinct_public_key_count": record["top_distinct_public_key_count"],
        "top_candidates": top_candidates,
        "historical_selected_public_action": sanitized_action(
            record["historical_selected_public_action"]
        ),
        "repaired_selected_public_action": sanitized_action(
            record["repaired_selected_public_action"]
        ),
        "historical_post_decision_full_state_hash": legacy_record[
            "post_decision_full_state_hash"
        ],
        "repaired_post_decision_full_state_hash": record[
            "post_decision_full_state_hash"
        ],
        "difference_attributable_only_to_final_ordering": True,
    }


def later_differences(repaired: dict[str, Any]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    result: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    for record in repaired["decisions"]:
        if not record["historical_and_repaired_selections_differ"]:
            continue
        result.append(
            {
                "decision_index": record["decision_index"],
                "turn_number": record["turn_number"],
                "phase": record["phase"],
                "step": record["step"],
                "pre_decision_full_state_hash": record[
                    "pre_decision_full_state_hash"
                ],
                "top_substantive_score_prefix": record[
                    "top_substantive_score_prefix"
                ],
                "historical_selected_public_action": sanitized_action(
                    record["historical_selected_public_action"]
                ),
                "repaired_selected_public_action": sanitized_action(
                    record["repaired_selected_public_action"]
                ),
            }
        )
    return result


def action_label(action: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    identity = action.get("public_identity") or "<no identity>"
    metadata = canonical(action.get("canonical_public_metadata", {}))
    return f"{action['action_kind']} / {identity} / metadata {metadata}"


def outcome(diag: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    value = dict(diag["summary"]["outcome"])
    value["public_action_sequence_sha256"] = diag["summary"][
        "actual_public_action_sequence_sha256"
    ]
    value["decision_count"] = diag["summary"]["decision_counts"][
        "total_standard_decisions"
    ]
    return value


def exact_selected_key(diag: dict[str, Any], index: int) -> str:
    return diag["decisions"][index]["actual_selected_public_action"][
        "public_action_key"
    ]


def build_analysis(
    repaired_101: dict[str, Any],
    legacy_101: dict[str, Any],
    repaired_391: dict[str, Any],
    legacy_391: dict[str, Any],
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    commits = {
        repaired_101["commit"],
        legacy_101["commit"],
        repaired_391["commit"],
        legacy_391["commit"],
    }
    trees = {
        repaired_101["tree"],
        legacy_101["tree"],
        repaired_391["tree"],
        legacy_391["tree"],
    }
    if len(commits) != 1 or len(trees) != 1:
        raise SystemExit("corrected diagnostics did not use one exact commit and tree")
    repaired_commit = next(iter(commits))
    repaired_tree = next(iter(trees))

    for diag in (repaired_101, legacy_101, repaired_391, legacy_391):
        current = diag["summary"]["outcome"]
        if not current["fresh_replay_equal"]:
            raise SystemExit("fresh replay equality failed")

    if outcome(legacy_101)["final_state_hash"] != HISTORICAL[101]["final_state_hash"]:
        raise SystemExit("full legacy selector no longer reproduces historical seed 101")
    if outcome(legacy_391)["final_state_hash"] != HISTORICAL[391730338978874520]["final_state_hash"]:
        raise SystemExit("full legacy selector no longer reproduces historical seed 391")
    if outcome(legacy_101)["actual_first_attempt_turn"] != 10:
        raise SystemExit("legacy selector did not reproduce seed 101 attempt turn")
    if outcome(legacy_101)["attempt_package"] != "malcolm_glint_horn":
        raise SystemExit("legacy selector did not reproduce seed 101 package")
    if outcome(legacy_391)["terminal_status"] != "TERMINAL":
        raise SystemExit("legacy selector did not reproduce seed 391 terminal state")
    if outcome(repaired_101)["terminal_status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise SystemExit("corrected repaired seed 101 was not active through Turn 10")
    if outcome(repaired_101)["actual_first_attempt_turn"] is not None:
        raise SystemExit("corrected repaired seed 101 unexpectedly attempted a combo")
    if outcome(repaired_391)["terminal_status"] != "ACTIVE":
        raise SystemExit("corrected repaired seed 391 was not active through Turn 10")

    first_101 = first_difference(repaired_101, legacy_101)
    first_391 = first_difference(repaired_391, legacy_391)
    if first_101["decision_index"] != 9 or first_391["decision_index"] != 9:
        raise SystemExit("unexpected first distinct-public-key selector divergence")

    return {
        "schema_version": "1.0.0",
        "title": "Phase C Public Tie-Break Behavioral Analysis",
        "historical_implementation": {
            "commit": HISTORICAL_COMMIT,
            "tree": HISTORICAL_TREE,
        },
        "handoff_repaired_head": HANDOFF_REPAIRED_COMMIT,
        "corrected_repaired_implementation": {
            "commit": repaired_commit,
            "tree": repaired_tree,
        },
        "mode": "STANDARD",
        "through_controlled_turn": 10,
        "policy_actions": True,
        "fresh_replay_validation": True,
        "seeds": {
            "101": {
                "historical_summary_outcome": HISTORICAL[101],
                "repaired_summary_outcome": outcome(repaired_101),
                "historical_decision_counts": HISTORICAL[101]["decision_counts"],
                "repaired_decision_counts": repaired_101["summary"][
                    "decision_counts"
                ],
                "first_divergence": first_101,
                "all_selector_divergences_on_repaired_path": later_differences(
                    repaired_101
                ),
                "divergences_before_changed_outcome_becomes_inevitable": None,
                "inevitability_finding": (
                    "No monotonic divergence count exists. Disposable prefix-budget clones "
                    "with legacy-difference budgets from 0 through 64 all remained ACTIVE "
                    "with no attempt; after two legacy choices, the hybrid path no longer "
                    "encountered the later historical choice states."
                ),
                "counterfactual_prefix_budget": PREFIX_BUDGET_EVIDENCE,
                "causal_conclusion": (
                    "The full legacy selector on the corrected repaired engine reproduces "
                    "the exact historical final hash and Turn-10 Malcolm/Glint-Horn attempt. "
                    "The repaired canonical public ordering follows a path-dependent cascade "
                    "of distinct-public-key ties and does not obtain legal deterministic "
                    "Malcolm/Glint-Horn access through Turn 10."
                ),
                "classification": [
                    "HISTORICAL_HIDDEN_TIEBREAK_DEPENDENCE",
                    "UNDER_SPECIFIED_STANDARD_SCORING",
                ],
            },
            "391730338978874520": {
                "historical_summary_outcome": HISTORICAL[391730338978874520],
                "repaired_summary_outcome": outcome(repaired_391),
                "historical_decision_counts": HISTORICAL[
                    391730338978874520
                ]["decision_counts"],
                "repaired_decision_counts": repaired_391["summary"][
                    "decision_counts"
                ],
                "first_divergence": first_391,
                "all_selector_divergences_on_repaired_path": later_differences(
                    repaired_391
                ),
                "divergences_before_changed_outcome_becomes_inevitable": None,
                "inevitability_finding": (
                    "The terminal result is the end of a path-dependent selector cascade; "
                    "the full legacy selector is sufficient to reproduce it exactly, but a "
                    "single early action substitution is not sufficient evidence of a fixed "
                    "inevitability threshold."
                ),
                "causal_conclusion": (
                    "The full legacy selector on the corrected repaired engine reproduces "
                    "the exact historical Turn-10 life-total table win. The repaired selector "
                    "first chooses a different public action at a substantive tie and follows "
                    "a legal nonterminal trajectory that leaves all opponents active through "
                    "Turn 10."
                ),
                "classification": [
                    "HISTORICAL_HIDDEN_TIEBREAK_DEPENDENCE",
                    "UNDER_SPECIFIED_STANDARD_SCORING",
                ],
            },
        },
        "public_boundary_finding": {
            "projection_defect_found": False,
            "public_key_defect_found": False,
            "equivalence_grouping_defect_found": False,
            "post_selection_resolution_defect_found": False,
            "evidence": (
                "Changing only the final selector back to the historical opaque-handle order "
                "on the corrected repaired engine reproduces both exact historical final "
                "state hashes and qualitative outcomes."
            ),
        },
        "independent_rules_defect": {
            "classification": "REPAIRED_IMPLEMENTATION_DEFECT",
            "rule": "Comprehensive Rules 903.9a",
            "finding": (
                "A declined commander move from graveyard or exile was incorrectly reoffered "
                "on every later state-based-action check. The general repair now creates the "
                "choice only when the commander actually enters graveyard or exile since the "
                "previous check, and permits a new choice after a later qualifying move."
            ),
            "relationship_to_tiebreak": (
                "This defect was exposed by the repaired seed-101 path but did not cause the "
                "historical-versus-public selector divergence."
            ),
        },
        "approved_policy_rule_search": {
            "existing_rule_resolves_all_ties": False,
            "finding": (
                "The frozen policy axes and documented STANDARD principles do not fully order "
                "the observed mana-color, card-selection-versus-development, target, X-value, "
                "cast-versus-pass, and other distinct public semantic ties."
            ),
        },
        "overall_classification": "MIXED",
        "owner_decision_required": True,
        "minimum_owner_decision": (
            "Decide whether canonical public ordering is the accepted deterministic baseline "
            "for strategically unresolved distinct-public-key ties, or approve a general "
            "public-semantic scoring hierarchy for those tie families. No seed-specific "
            "preference is technically justified."
        ),
        "measured": [
            "Seed 101 changed from a Turn-10 Malcolm/Glint-Horn attempt to no attempt through Turn 10.",
            "Seed 391730338978874520 changed from a Turn-10 life-total terminal table win to ACTIVE through Turn 10.",
            "The exact first distinct-public-key selector divergence and all later selector divergences on each repaired path.",
            "Exact historical outcome reproduction under the full legacy selector on the corrected repaired engine.",
        ],
        "unmeasured": [
            "Frequency of distinct-public-key final-score ties across the historical 500 STANDARD games.",
            "Number of historical pilot outcomes affected.",
            "Population effect on Turn-5, Turn-6, Turn-8, or Turn-10 access.",
            "Population effect on attempts, packages, mulligans, or paired statistics.",
            "Whether the historical 16.4% Turn-8 result was inflated, reduced, or unchanged.",
        ],
        "validation": {"status": "PENDING", "commands": []},
        "governance": {
            "corrected_pilot_authorized": False,
            "new_small_pilot_authorized": False,
            "replacement_500_200_pilot_authorized": False,
            "full_study_authorized": False,
            "historical_artifacts_modified": False,
            "pr_100_certified": False,
            "pr_99_modified_or_integrated": False,
        },
    }


def write_json(repo: Path, analysis: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path = repo / "docs/audit/phase-c-postpilot/PHASE_C_PUBLIC_TIEBREAK_BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(analysis, indent=2, sort_keys=True) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")


def candidates_markdown(first: dict[str, Any]) -> str:
    lines = []
    for candidate in first["top_candidates"]:
        lines.append(
            f"- `{action_label(candidate)}` with score prefix "
            f"`{candidate['substantive_score_prefix']}`"
        )
    return "\n".join(lines)


def write_markdown(repo: Path, analysis: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    seed_101 = analysis["seeds"]["101"]
    seed_391 = analysis["seeds"]["391730338978874520"]
    first_101 = seed_101["first_divergence"]
    first_391 = seed_391["first_divergence"]
    repaired = analysis["corrected_repaired_implementation"]
    text = f"""# Phase C Public Tie-Break Behavioral Analysis

Date: 2026-08-15

## Status

This is a targeted, observation-only investigation of two frozen STANDARD seeds. It is not a pilot, a pilot reanalysis, a certification, or authorization for the full study. PR #100 remains draft and uncertified. Issue #52 remains open.

## Exact implementations

- Historical commit: `{HISTORICAL_COMMIT}`
- Historical tree: `{HISTORICAL_TREE}`
- Corrected repaired commit used for the exact diagnostics: `{repaired['commit']}`
- Corrected repaired tree: `{repaired['tree']}`
- Mode: `STANDARD`
- Horizon: through controlled Turn 10
- Policy actions: enabled
- Fresh replay: required and equal for every reported execution

The corrected repaired implementation includes the public-action-key boundary and a separate general Rule 903.9a repair described below. No pilot measurement artifact root was created.

## Method

Every STANDARD decision was observed without changing action enumeration, substantive scoring, legality, RNG, replay, or execution. The trace recorded the public observation digest, full pre-decision state hash, public action classes, substantive score prefix before the final ordering, selected public keys, and post-decision state hashes. Opaque handles were used only inside temporary diagnostic evidence to reproduce the historical selector and are not part of this durable report.

A decisive counterfactual was then run on the corrected repaired engine: the full historical final selector was restored without changing projection, public keys, legality, execution, or the rest of the engine. That counterfactual reproduced both exact historical final hashes and outcomes.

## Seed 101

### Outcomes

- Historical: `ACTIVE` through Turn 10, 458 commands, first actual attempt on Turn 10, package `malcolm_glint_horn`, final hash `{HISTORICAL[101]['final_state_hash']}`.
- Repaired: `{seed_101['repaired_summary_outcome']['terminal_status']}` through Turn 10, {seed_101['repaired_summary_outcome']['command_count']} commands, no actual attempt through Turn 10, final hash `{seed_101['repaired_summary_outcome']['final_state_hash']}`.
- Repaired public-action sequence digest: `{seed_101['repaired_summary_outcome']['public_action_sequence_sha256']}`.

### First distinct-public-key divergence

The complete pre-decision state and public observation were identical. The first strategically nonvacuous difference occurred at decision {first_101['decision_index']} on Turn {first_101['turn_number']} during `{first_101['phase']}` / `{first_101['step']}`. The top substantive prefix was `{first_101['top_substantive_score_prefix']}`.

Tied top public actions:

{candidates_markdown(first_101)}

Historical selection:

- `{action_label(first_101['historical_selected_public_action'])}`

Repaired selection:

- `{action_label(first_101['repaired_selected_public_action'])}`

The difference is attributable only to opaque-handle ordering versus canonical public-key ordering. It is not caused by projection, equivalence grouping, or post-selection handle resolution.

### Causal trace

The initial mana-order difference is not by itself an inevitability proof. Later repaired-path ties include strategically different public choices involving mana colors, card use, targets, X values, and cast-versus-pass decisions. Disposable prefix-budget clones applying up to 64 historical selector differences did not produce a monotonic recovery threshold: after two applied differences, the hybrid trajectory no longer reached the later historical choice states.

The full legacy selector counterfactual did recover the exact historical final hash and the Turn-10 Malcolm/Glint-Horn attempt. Under the repaired selector, Malcolm/Glint-Horn deterministic access was not legally available later through Turn 10. The repaired policy therefore did not decline an already available deterministic attempt; it followed a different legal trajectory that never assembled the access. The historical attempt depended on the complete hidden-derived selector cascade.

Classification: `HISTORICAL_HIDDEN_TIEBREAK_DEPENDENCE` and `UNDER_SPECIFIED_STANDARD_SCORING`.

## Seed 391730338978874520

### Outcomes

- Historical: `TERMINAL` on controlled Turn 10, 1081 commands, final hash `{HISTORICAL[391730338978874520]['final_state_hash']}`.
- Historical terminal reason: `LIFE_TOTAL`. {HISTORICAL[391730338978874520]['terminal_explanation']}
- Repaired: `{seed_391['repaired_summary_outcome']['terminal_status']}` through Turn 10, {seed_391['repaired_summary_outcome']['command_count']} commands, final hash `{seed_391['repaired_summary_outcome']['final_state_hash']}`.
- Repaired public-action sequence digest: `{seed_391['repaired_summary_outcome']['public_action_sequence_sha256']}`.

### First distinct-public-key divergence

The complete pre-decision state and public observation were identical. The first strategically nonvacuous difference occurred at decision {first_391['decision_index']} on Turn {first_391['turn_number']} during `{first_391['phase']}` / `{first_391['step']}`. The top substantive prefix was `{first_391['top_substantive_score_prefix']}`.

Tied top public actions:

{candidates_markdown(first_391)}

Historical selection:

- `{action_label(first_391['historical_selected_public_action'])}`

Repaired selection:

- `{action_label(first_391['repaired_selected_public_action'])}`

The historical selector chose the Opt public action selected by opaque-handle order; the repaired selector chose the canonically later public key, which develops Siren Stormtamer. The substantive evaluator gives these strategically different public actions the same prefix. The repaired line is legal and remains nonterminal through Turn 10; it avoids the historical Niv-Mizzet/Curiosity terminal table-win trajectory rather than missing a terminal condition already present in its own state.

Classification: `HISTORICAL_HIDDEN_TIEBREAK_DEPENDENCE` and `UNDER_SPECIFIED_STANDARD_SCORING`.

## Cross-seed conclusion

The public information-boundary repair is structurally correct. No defect was found in public projection, public keys, equivalence grouping, substantive-prefix preservation, or post-selection execution resolution. Restoring only the historical final selector on the corrected repaired engine reproduces both exact historical outcomes. This establishes historical hidden-tie-break dependence.

The same evidence also establishes that the substantive STANDARD evaluator is under-specified for distinct public semantic actions. Canonical public JSON is safe and deterministic, but it is not a strategic justification for preferring one tied action over another. Existing frozen policy axes do not fully resolve the observed tie families. No production scoring preference was added.

Overall classification: `MIXED`.

## Independent Rule 903.9a defect

The repaired seed-101 path exposed a separate engine defect. After a player declined to move a commander from graveyard or exile to the command zone, the engine reoffered the same choice on every later state-based-action check. Rule 903.9a permits the choice only when the commander entered graveyard or exile since the previous check.

The general repair now creates the pending choice when the qualifying zone move occurs, removes stale pending entries when the object moves, does not reoffer after a decline, and offers a new choice after a later qualifying move. Focused Phase A and Phase B tests cover both behaviors. This defect did not cause the historical-versus-public selector divergence.

## Owner decision required

An owner methodology decision remains required. The minimum decision is whether canonical public ordering is the accepted deterministic baseline for strategically unresolved distinct-public-key ties, or whether to approve a general public-semantic scoring hierarchy for the affected tie families. A seed-specific rule to recover Malcolm/Glint-Horn or the historical terminal result is not justified.

## Measured and unmeasured scope

Measured:

- Seed 101 changed from a Turn-10 Malcolm/Glint-Horn attempt to no attempt through Turn 10.
- Seed 391730338978874520 changed from a Turn-10 life-total terminal table win to remaining active through Turn 10.
- The exact first distinct-public-key divergence and all later selector divergences on each repaired path.
- Exact historical outcome reproduction under the full legacy selector on the corrected repaired engine.

Not measured:

- Frequency of distinct-public-key final-score ties across the historical 500 STANDARD games.
- Number of historical pilot outcomes affected.
- Population effects on Turn-5, Turn-6, Turn-8, or Turn-10 access.
- Population effects on attempt counts, package counts, mulligans, or paired statistics.
- Whether the historical 16.4% Turn-8 result was inflated, reduced, or unchanged.

## Validation

<!-- VALIDATION_RESULTS -->

## Governance

- Corrected pilot authorized: `false`
- New small pilot authorized: `false`
- Replacement 500/200 pilot authorized: `false`
- Full study authorized: `false`
- Historical pilot artifacts modified: `false`
- PR #100 certified: `false`
- PR #99 modified or integrated: `false`
"""
    path = repo / "docs/audit/phase-c-postpilot/PHASE_C_PUBLIC_TIEBREAK_BEHAVIORAL_ANALYSIS.md"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def write_addendum(repo: Path, analysis: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    seed_101 = analysis["seeds"]["101"]
    seed_391 = analysis["seeds"]["391730338978874520"]
    first_101 = seed_101["first_divergence"]
    first_391 = seed_391["first_divergence"]
    repaired = analysis["corrected_repaired_implementation"]
    text = f"""# Phase C Post-Pilot Hidden-Information Noninterference Addendum

Date: 2026-08-15

## Status and scope

This addendum records a verified information-boundary limitation in the historical Phase C pilot implementation and two measured frozen-seed consequences. It does not alter, replace, recompute, or reinterpret historical pilot artifact bytes. It does not authorize a corrected pilot, a new small pilot, a replacement 500/200 pilot, post-result reanalysis, or the 20,000 STANDARD / 5,000 EXPLORATORY full study.

Issue #52 remains the owner decision gate for future study authorization.

## Historical implementation boundary

The historical pilot remains an exact, replay-valid record of implementation:

`{HISTORICAL_COMMIT}`

Tree:

`{HISTORICAL_TREE}`

That implementation used the opaque `ActionBroker.handle` as the final STANDARD tie-break. The capability handle was appropriate for execution binding but not for strategic ranking because it depended on complete broker state and enumeration position while the policy observation intentionally excluded hidden information.

The repaired public-policy implementation projects legal actions to handle-free public action views, selects a complete public semantic key, and resolves an execution capability only after the public class is selected. The corrected repaired diagnostic commit was `{repaired['commit']}` with tree `{repaired['tree']}`.

## What is now measured

Two frozen non-pilot regression seeds demonstrate that replacing the historical opaque-handle tie-break can materially alter STANDARD trajectories. Seed 101 changed from a Turn-10 Malcolm/Glint-Horn attempt to no attempt through Turn 10, and seed 391730338978874520 changed from a Turn-10 life-total terminal table-win trajectory to remaining active through Turn 10. These observations establish that the repair can affect individual outcomes. They do not quantify its prevalence or numerical effect across the historical 500-game pilot.

For seed 101, the first distinct-public-key divergence occurred at decision {first_101['decision_index']} on Turn {first_101['turn_number']}. The historical and repaired runs had the same full pre-decision state hash and public observation digest. Distinct public mana actions shared the same substantive score prefix, after which the selectors followed a path-dependent cascade of later ties.

For seed 391730338978874520, the first distinct-public-key divergence occurred at decision {first_391['decision_index']} on Turn {first_391['turn_number']}. The historical selector chose an Opt public action, while the repaired selector chose Siren Stormtamer from the same substantive score prefix. The historical path later produced a Niv-Mizzet, Parun and Curiosity draw-and-damage loop that reduced all opponents to 0 life on Turn 10; the repaired path remained legal and active.

A full legacy-selector counterfactual on the corrected repaired engine reproduced both exact historical final state hashes and qualitative outcomes. That evidence attributes the trajectory changes to historical hidden-derived final ordering and an under-specified substantive STANDARD score, not to a defect in public projection, equivalence grouping, or post-selection resolution.

The investigation also found and corrected an independent Rule 903.9a defect: a declined commander graveyard/exile move was being reoffered on later state-based-action checks without a new qualifying zone move. That defect was exposed by the repaired seed-101 path but did not cause the selector divergence.

## What remains unmeasured

The following remain unknown and were not inferred from two seeds:

- frequency of distinct-public-key final-score ties across the historical 500 STANDARD games;
- number of historical pilot outcomes affected;
- population effect on Turn-5, Turn-6, Turn-8, or Turn-10 access;
- population effect on attempt counts, package counts, mulligans, or paired statistics;
- whether the historical 16.4% Turn-8 result was materially inflated, reduced, or unchanged.

The historical 16.4% Turn-8 result, historical Turn-10 result, and historical paired statistics are not revised by this addendum. Future results from a repaired implementation would be results from a different STANDARD policy implementation and require explicit owner authorization and an approved comparison design.

## Methodology consequence

Canonical public ordering is deterministic and hidden-information safe. The investigation does not establish that it is a strategically preferred order when distinct public actions tie under the substantive score. Existing frozen policy rules do not fully resolve the observed tie families. A new strategic scoring hierarchy therefore remains an owner-level methodology decision. No seed-specific preference was added.

## Governance

- Corrected pilot authorized: `false`
- New small pilot authorized: `false`
- Replacement 500/200 pilot authorized: `false`
- Full study authorized: `false`
- Historical pilot artifacts modified: `false`
- PR #100 certified: `false`
- PR #99 modified or integrated: `false`
"""
    path = repo / "docs/audit/phase-c-postpilot/PHASE_C_POSTPILOT_NONINTERFERENCE_ADDENDUM.md"
    path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")


def patch_turn10_smoke(repo: Path, repaired_101: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    path = repo / "scripts/check_phase_c_turn10.py"
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    marker = "# PR100_POSITIVE_PUBLIC_TRAJECTORY"
    if marker in text:
        raise SystemExit("Turn-10 smoke already contains the PR #100 positive contract")
    marker_index = text.find('if __name__ == "__main__":')
    if marker_index < 0:
        marker_index = text.find("if __name__ == '__main__':")
    if marker_index < 0:
        raise SystemExit("cannot locate check_phase_c_turn10.py entrypoint")
    prefix = text[:marker_index].rstrip() + "\n\n"
    positive = outcome(repaired_101)
    first = first_difference(repaired_101, load(Path("."), "legacy", 101)) if False else None
    expected_key = exact_selected_key(repaired_101, 9)
    helper = f'''# PR100_POSITIVE_PUBLIC_TRAJECTORY

def _check_positive_public_trajectory() -> None:
    import hashlib
    import json

    import mtg_policy.standard as standard_module
    from mtg_runs.phase_c_runner import run_phase_c_game_execution

    selected_public_keys: list[str] = []
    original_resolve = standard_module.resolve_selected_action_handle

    def traced_resolve(actions, selected_key):
        selected_public_keys.append(selected_key.canonical_json)
        return original_resolve(actions, selected_key)

    standard_module.resolve_selected_action_handle = traced_resolve
    try:
        execution = run_phase_c_game_execution(
            seed=101,
            mode="STANDARD",
            through_turn=10,
            validate_fresh_replay=True,
            policy_actions=True,
        )
    finally:
        standard_module.resolve_selected_action_handle = original_resolve

    technical = execution.technical_game
    measurement = execution.measurement
    sequence_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(
            selected_public_keys,
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ).encode()
    ).hexdigest()

    assert technical.controlled_turns_completed == {positive['controlled_turns_completed']}
    assert technical.terminal_status == {positive['terminal_status']!r}
    assert technical.command_count == {positive['command_count']}
    assert technical.final_state_hash == {positive['final_state_hash']!r}
    assert technical.fresh_replay_state_hash == technical.final_state_hash
    assert len(selected_public_keys) == {positive['decision_count']}
    assert sequence_digest == {positive['public_action_sequence_sha256']!r}
    assert selected_public_keys[9] == {expected_key!r}
    # Supplemental absence assertions; the positive trajectory contract above is primary.
    assert measurement.actual_first_attempt_turn is None
    assert measurement.attempt_package is None
'''
    entry = '''if __name__ == "__main__":
    status = main()
    _check_positive_public_trajectory()
    raise SystemExit(status)
'''
    path.write_text(prefix + helper + "\n" + entry, encoding="utf-8")


def write_terminal_test(repo: Path, repaired_391: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    positive = outcome(repaired_391)
    expected_key = exact_selected_key(repaired_391, 9)
    content = f'''from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json

import mtg_policy.standard as standard_module
from mtg_runs.phase_c_runner import run_phase_c_game_execution


def test_repaired_public_tiebreak_seed_391730338978874520_is_positive_and_replay_equal(
    monkeypatch,
) -> None:
    selected_public_keys: list[str] = []
    original_resolve = standard_module.resolve_selected_action_handle

    def traced_resolve(actions, selected_key):
        selected_public_keys.append(selected_key.canonical_json)
        return original_resolve(actions, selected_key)

    monkeypatch.setattr(
        standard_module, "resolve_selected_action_handle", traced_resolve
    )
    execution = run_phase_c_game_execution(
        seed=391730338978874520,
        mode="STANDARD",
        through_turn=10,
        validate_fresh_replay=True,
        policy_actions=True,
    )
    technical = execution.technical_game
    sequence_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        json.dumps(
            selected_public_keys,
            sort_keys=True,
            separators=(",", ":"),
            ensure_ascii=False,
        ).encode()
    ).hexdigest()

    assert technical.terminal_status == {positive['terminal_status']!r}
    assert technical.controlled_turns_completed == {positive['controlled_turns_completed']}
    assert technical.command_count == {positive['command_count']}
    assert technical.final_state_hash == {positive['final_state_hash']!r}
    assert technical.fresh_replay_state_hash == technical.final_state_hash
    assert len(selected_public_keys) == {positive['decision_count']}
    assert sequence_digest == {positive['public_action_sequence_sha256']!r}
    assert selected_public_keys[9] == {expected_key!r}
'''
    path = repo / "tests/phase_c/test_phase_c_terminal_cleanup.py"
    path.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--evidence", type=Path, required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    repo = args.repo.resolve()
    evidence = args.evidence.resolve()

    repaired_101 = load(evidence, "repaired", 101)
    legacy_101 = load(evidence, "legacy", 101)
    repaired_391 = load(evidence, "repaired", 391730338978874520)
    legacy_391 = load(evidence, "legacy", 391730338978874520)
    analysis = build_analysis(
        repaired_101, legacy_101, repaired_391, legacy_391
    )
    write_json(repo, analysis)
    write_markdown(repo, analysis)
    write_addendum(repo, analysis)
    patch_turn10_smoke(repo, repaired_101)
    write_terminal_test(repo, repaired_391)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
